- Grail reward hold-to-fill button updated (we fixed the spend-experience one last patch, missed this one until now)
- fixed a nuisance-highlighting issue on career buttons on character generation page
- couldn't delete saves after leaving and retunring to main menu - can now 
- Zèlia: added a tutorial warning that she's unpredictable, clarified a couple of player choices
- "le" not "la" malaise, je parle français comme une vache anglaise
- updated unstuck button, escape menu border

## 2026.8.j.17 - "WHAT I WAS WALLING IN OR WALLING OUT"

- fixed those spots people where getting stranded - the café, that bloody flower in the park, a couple of other places. Loading after update should silently rescue you. Thank you to screamingreen-rocket, cadetgrey-sage, linen-madder, pearl-filipendula and many others! 
- if loading after update doesn't rescue you silently, hit the UNSTUCK button (button with key symbol on options menu)
- fixed mysterious Shivering message on exiting Sanitarium; climate also takes a few seconds to kick in when entering cutaways
- fixed a crash during scene transitions
- updated the Grail hold-to-fill button so you can see it filling
- Lewis painting in Sanitarium no longer visible before unshrouding
- Wardrobe header no longer misdirects to Skill Modifiers

## 2026.8.j.8 - "THE LITTLE BOX"

- helpful nudge towards the ESCAPE! button if you're clicking frustratedly
- added a 'beware, dabblers' tutorial message for occult activities
- it's now harder to die in the bath
- updated the well-groomed status effect icon
- fixed a complicated footnote-text-overlap thing
- copy fixes! coooohpy fixes!

## 2026.8.j.4 - "IMAGINARY HOTELS"

- back button on footnotes
- restored Father Jaume's portrait
- added escape hatch when interacting with the bed at night so it no longer forces immediate sleep 
- ghastly bug where closing-reopening a dialogue quickly enough could get you stuck - hopefully now fixed
- various item-aspect picker bugs (crashed, survived load, unlocked options it shouldn't)
- you can no longer lock a cutway half-open by lingering in the doorway
- YOU CAN NO LONGER RELOAD FROM THE ENDING-SAVE OR SNEAK ROUND THE ZONE TRIGGER. STOP TRYING TO EXPLORE MIMATA. THE CONVERSATIONS HAVE BEEN STRIPPED OUT ANYWAY

- sanitarium layering fixes; stairs easier to descend
- kitchen door no longer opens in the upper story when Chez Felix closes
- Andrée no longer encourages you to leave the shop before speaking to you
- Barber's Tower text is no longer missing
- Tennyson-honouring tweak - tho corrected to tho'
- copy fixes
- btw these version labels are from Simic's book on Joseph Cornell, 'Dime-Store Alchemy', which I highly recommend. but I've almost run out

- that landscape seam in the art is now fixed. Thanks to EVERYONE who reported it :-)
- swapping stacks in the inventory borked stack number display - now fixed
- shortened invisible bag tooltip - I got carried away with the Dunsany quotes
- character outlines were out of step on 16:9 monitors
- Rodia: can only introduce yourself once

## 2026.8.j.34 - "MASS FOR THE IMPRISONED"

- Lots more work on pathfinding in Antibes
- game ended at Dread/Fascination/Pain 11, not 10 - fixed now
- crafting HUD fixes: correct images, removed overlapping 'YOU ARE HERE'
- Grail reward hold-to-fill button updated (we fixed the spend-experience one last patch, missed this one until now)
- fixed a nuisance-highlighting issue on career buttons on character generation page
- couldn't delete saves after leaving and retunring to main menu - can now 
- Zèlia: added a tutorial warning that she's unpredictable, clarified a couple of player choices
- "le" not "la" malaise, je parle français comme une vache anglaise
- updated unstuck button, escape menu border

## 2026.8.j.17 - "WHAT I WAS WALLING IN OR WALLING OUT"

- fixed those spots people where getting stranded - the café, that bloody flower in the park, a couple of other places. Loading after update should silently rescue you. Thank you to screamingreen-rocket, cadetgrey-sage, linen-madder, pearl-filipendula and many others! 
- if loading after update doesn't rescue you silently, hit the UNSTUCK button (button with key symbol on options menu)
- fixed mysterious Shivering message on exiting Sanitarium; climate also takes a few seconds to kick in when entering cutaways
- fixed a crash during scene transitions
- updated the Grail hold-to-fill button so you can see it filling
- Lewis painting in Sanitarium no longer visible before unshrouding
- Wardrobe header no longer misdirects to Skill Modifiers

## 2026.8.j.8 - "THE LITTLE BOX"

- helpful nudge towards the ESCAPE! button if you're clicking frustratedly
- added a 'beware, dabblers' tutorial message for occult activities
- it's now harder to die in the bath
- updated the well-groomed status effect icon
- fixed a complicated footnote-text-overlap thing
- copy fixes! coooohpy fixes!

## 2026.8.j.4 - "IMAGINARY HOTELS"

- back button on footnotes
- restored Father Jaume's portrait
- added escape hatch when interacting with the bed at night so it no longer forces immediate sleep 
- ghastly bug where closing-reopening a dialogue quickly enough could get you stuck - hopefully now fixed
- various item-aspect picker bugs (crashed, survived load, unlocked options it shouldn't)
- you can no longer lock a cutway half-open by lingering in the doorway
- YOU CAN NO LONGER RELOAD FROM THE ENDING-SAVE OR SNEAK ROUND THE ZONE TRIGGER. STOP TRYING TO EXPLORE MIMATA. THE CONVERSATIONS HAVE BEEN STRIPPED OUT ANYWAY
- maybe - maybe? fixed special-character email input on Linux? idk, man, it's Linux, what can I tell you
- Lottie has laid down the law on the trees at the left hand end of the road by Antibes station
- sanitarium layering fixes; stairs easier to descend
- kitchen door no longer opens in the upper story when Chez Felix closes
- Andrée no longer encourages you to leave the shop before speaking to you
- Barber's Tower text is no longer missing
- Tennyson-honouring tweak - tho corrected to tho'
- copy fixes
- btw these version labels are from Simic's book on Joseph Cornell, 'Dime-Store Alchemy', which I highly recommend. but I've almost run out

## 2026.8.i.71 - "UTOPIA CUISINE"

- that landscape seam in the art is now fixed. Thanks to EVERYONE who reported it :-)
- swapping stacks in the inventory borked stack number display - now fixed
- shortened invisible bag tooltip - I got carried away with the Dunsany quotes
- character outlines were out of step on 16:9 monitors
- Rodia: can only introduce yourself once
- Clicking an already-ticked journal box doesn't get you stuck.
- can't get stuck asking Zèlia about Nina or haggling over her [SPOILER]
- station trees, edge collider fixes, school sign fix, church pews fix, Pompon fixes
- Options: Visuals sliders no longer jitter; Apply/Cancel buttons moved for clarity 
- LOTS of other copy and collider+pathfinding fixes!

## 2026.8.i.62 - "PART OF THE MISSING WHOLE"

- MAC / LAPTOP USERS: press T to focus tooltips. Soz, really meant to get that in for launch!
- Vincent now follows the PC's trail directly, meaning less teleporting through doors
- fixed Worm and Sun links
- Fascination no longer gives penalties at levels 1-3
- fixed a nasty edge case where an *untrained* skill could be used ahead of a very-low-value *trained* skill
- clicking the PC / companion portrait no longer also queues a click-to-move
- library grate highlight hidden while library shrouded
- you don't have to go outside to look at Janvier's third photo
- you do have to go into Chez Felix kitchen to open the fridge
- fixed Active Tools->Items header
- fixed game-complete save typo
- Japanese / IME keyboard users can now submit bug reports without having_to_use_underscores_for_spaces
- skill check preview/result tooltips no longer float off the top or bottom of the screen
- consent toggle preserves difference between 'Unchosen' and 'No'. Previously it reverted to No, which was super-polite but slightly confusing. 
- also you can read the news without deciding on data-consent
- swapped Edge and Winter influences when looking at the lake painting
- swapped wrongly-swapped Aspects when reacting to a footnote about a particular Hour
- Added Hattington and Ambler to quotes
- bath is now invisible until you're in the bathroom
- copy fixes 

## 2026.8.i.23 - "CIGARS CLAMPED BETWEEN THEIR TEETH"

* Tragically, had to remove Reinhardt's 'Nuages' - turns out it's public domain in the EU and Canada but not in the US :(
* Likewise with the Reinhardt version of 'Darktown Strutters' Ball' which we've replaced with PD period music Chez Felix
* failing to load an incompatible save no longer spams endless notifications (3c037130e)
* fixed borked door plaque at night
* fixed guest chair in Aub's office
* Punched up the ESCAPE! unstuck function
* added icons for the Chez Félix drinks

## 2026.8.i.6 - "BUT ONCE, WHISPERS THE NIGHT"

* Another round of fixes for weird graph bubble trap problems ('spencer gets stuck)
* new ESCAPE! tab in the options menu: manual escape from a stuck position, emergency only. Spencer can always get out.
* right-click dismisses all visible toasts (there's a tutorial message, which you can also right-click dismiss with the rest)
* inline alerts bundles play one sound at the end.
* skill preview tooltips now render to the left of the dialogue. This was driving Lottie BATS
* Vincent reaction tweak
* dialogue is more close-mouthed about Zèlia's scheme if you didn't buy into it
* 

## 2026.8.i.1 - "THERE ARE POETS WHO SERVICE CHURCH CLOCKS"

* The watermark has changed from BETA to DEMO. Don't allow this to frighten you - the public demo is not yet quite live.
* UI sound effects! Do let us know what you like - but please first give it a couple of hours to bed in. If you've
already been playing the game, it will initially seem very chatty.
* music and ambience duck independently in conversation; at composer's request, default music volume is a little quieter
* typewriter dialogue auto-scroll smoothed - let us know how you get on with it
* Bessy's omelette Circumstance no longer enigmatic, now explains itself
* Vincent dialogue rephrased to make clear he offers to come with you; fixed one of hist footnote links.
* fixed broken links in several footnotes
* no-choice footnotes no longer shown as 'unchosen choices' (eventually this will be nuncupatory when all have choices)
* ellipsise-ing over-long footnote-search rows
* travel requirements for distant map destinations no longer display FNORD text
* gave Choices display a haircut
* inventory skill-modifier work
* Antibes layering bug fixes
* if you completed one Aubière Plan and didn't claim the rewards before completing another, you could get locked out of rewards - fixed
* autosave rose indicator in TopHUD + autosave message update
* TopHUD button hover labels
* new journal icons; fixed journal associate size
* character sheet UI and inventory cubby use fewer placeholder assets
* added missing recipe icons for Rites

## 2026.8.h.45 - "THE MAGIC STUDY OF HAPPINESS"

* This is the RC build for the demo. Demo is out Monday 10th, in a week.
* This means YOUR BETA KEYS WILL STOP WORKING AT THE WEEKEND. If you're nearly at the end and want to finish it, do so now, THE DEMO WILL INVALIDATE OLDER SAVES
* fixed really nasty bug where a skill preview check would include bonuses from a one-use item but then THE ONE-USE ITEM WOULD BE USED UP BEFORE THE RULE
* and better alignment on the skill-check preview
* Spencer will now walk all the way to the target dot, rather than stopping short of it. (We used to have a much bigger target graphic)
* Spencer will now deign to walk smaller distances (about half the previous limit for 'is it worth moving, I'm already pretty close')
* recipe and journal focus panes now display links correctly
* more legible styling for links on red-background focus panes
* any Unveil item, not just Wakeful Eye, will now let you find a certain hidden door
* Aubière *should* now have his gràvè àccènt everywhere. as an Englisher I kèèp forgètting to àdd it
* all Plans now have Significance. I mean that they're now categorised to a Significance level, but the terser phrasing is funner.

## 2026.7.h.8 - "CENTURIES OF JUNE"

* Spencer can sometimes identify a certain precious substance
* tutorial guard wasn't blocking travel to wrong destinations: fix
* character creation: Shift/Ctrl on a skill +/- button goes faster
* new hover tooltip on the inline skill-check result bar as well as the \[Success] \[Failure] text
* really paranoid precaution added to stop people getting stuck in conversation interstitials
* in-game bug report is now draggable
* fixed several more music-override glitches
* copy and object-use fixes
* cleaner requirement prefixes in Linou's dialogue and in relationship requirement prefixes generally
* some new sanitarium sfx
* usual typo sweep

## 2026.7.h.2 - "POSTAGE STAMP WITH A PYRAMID"

* Calendrier conversation fix
* zero-skill entries greyed out in inventory skill bars to show that you can't modify them
* Strathcoyne won't speak to you while you're wearing a dressing gown; Rodia and Aub have something to say about it; and you can't go out in the street undressed.
* everyone can take a bath once per Antibes visit
* Spencer's wardrobe is clickable (and the wardrobe zone still works)
* Ithastry no longer crafts Knock-memories. We wanted two skills per subversion... but Knock is always the exception.
* updated recipe descriptions
* new loading-screen tips
* footnote fixes
* more sfx, tweaked music
* kitchen venue highlight and Bessy's shadow now both fade
* quote-scene fonts changed
* Venue hover fixes
* removed the Camera Tracking options toggle; confirmed no-one was using Lock To Centre, as we suspected
* Apply button no longer stays greyed when you pick the native resolution
* fixed active-item name overflow (e.g. "Third Republic Passport \[INVALID]")
* stopped some nonsense nonsensing in the Escape Menu
* crafting tree: prettier connector lines
* crafting HUD round 3: recipe preview/focus pane, clickable locked recipes, per-row level/venue marks, inline venue icons in messages, picker Clear button
* crafting: fixed possible loss of a crafted-but-uncollected item when saving while hovering the recipe tree
* fixed a crash on mouseless sessions,
* "I bring you FIRE"
* Office of Onteiric Coordination +
* typo and copy fixes

## 2026.7.g.99 - "STREET-CORNER THEOLOGY"

* If you went to Mimata and then started a new game, Spencer found himself back in Mimata after you opened and closed any HUD menu. I mean, everyone likes Mimata. But we fixed that.
* Also fixed stale skill-check results and footnote back-history leaking into a new game
= Crafting menu overhaul! some placeholder assets in there, but the flow is clearer and it's easier to explore the web
* fixed movement tutorials re-firing on re-entering Antibes after they were dismissed
* tutorials now count as seen when shown. You don't have to dismiss them before they go away.
* Added missing descriptions for recipes.
* sorting-order fixes for beach trees, Linou's caff, cacti and more

## 2026.7.g.89 - "CRAVING SHADOWS"

* active-item slots now accept any item with skill modifiers, not just Tools. This has been half-complete for months - I finally pushed the button
* in related news, passports now have skill modifiers
* dropping an active item onto its own cubby unequips it, eligible active slots light up when an inventory drag begins, UI needs a little work
* the mouse cursor has never looked quite right when dragging an item. so now we hide it when dragging an item. cerebro galactico
* each career starts with a Tier D crafting item
* adopt requirement prefix shows the Aspect label rather than its id (1230c451f)
* wellGroomed / morningRites are now better-groomed
* *les veuves poisseuses*
* fixed the freeze on re-entering the sanitarium from Antibes — spawn point was inside the front door's collider
* Linux now ships Vulkan-first with GL Core as fallback - 0.5% of you will no longer see Antibes looking washed out. Thanks to J.C for helping track this one down
* fixed options dropdowns rendering blank in builds
* fixed various music glitches
* fixed the bug-report dialog overflowing the screen on ultrawide
* can't click through the merchant window now
* scene transitions now restore the pause state instead of forcing time back on
* trimmed some of the instrumentation out of logs
* usual round of copy and typo fixes

## 2026.7.g.65 - "A FORCE ILLEGIBLE"

* lots of dialogue fixes across Antibes and the sanitarium
* Mark of Necessity and Eye of Authority now correctly consumed as fuel
* fixed being able to walk around while the merchant window was open, after closing the bug reporter
* horrible pause-leak bug
* can't click through credits and news windows
* fixed credits and news windows not rendering
* fixed the Sign Info panel being invisible. It's been invisible for MONTHS
* fixed the info window keeping the previous subject's advice line. Probably
* nicer music transition from the main menu

## 2026.7.g.42 - "IT'S *AN* ANSWER"

* added instrumentation for a frankly bewildering gl-core Linux lighting bug. idk man, I'm just a writer, why did I think I could make video games
* fixed a dead end in the conversation with Strathcoyne about someone being naughty
* reworded a confused exchange about Zèlia being confused which was more confused than it was meant to be.
* oho this one was fun. Reporting a bug in-game then closing the bug dialogue unpaused the game, even if you were in the merchant window. Fixed.
* but keep an eye out for pause bugs, the logic here is fiendish
* easier to reach the door to outside in the sanitarium
* PC party block portrait displays correctly if you're wearing your old uniform
* venue footnote fix
* fixed the MERCHANT BUYS caption being covered by its own aspect icons
* fixed the opening quote screen restarting on repeated clicks.
* Also HOKOBALD APPEARED TWICE IN THE QUOTES ROTATION AND HAD REPLACED ILLOPOLY. IT'S ALWAYS BLOODY HOKO
* fixed an error when an NPC entered a cutaway zone with no player character present, which it turns out can happen occasionally after all

## 2026.7.g.32 - "WINTER DOES NOT WAIT FOREVER"

* (hotfixed) music wasn't playing, some audio was missing

## 2026.7.g.27 - "STOP IT ARISTIDE"

* if you spoke to Leopold or JB in the cafe instead of Aristide, Aristide pretended to be them. He won't now.
* refreshment limit at the antibes bar now counts every drink ordered (not just distinct drinks) and its stated number matches the actual cap
* fixed dead right-click "read" options on five package items
* inventory items now play their activation sound on Use/Refresh, not only Read
* packages are now resources (offering Use) rather than papers; letters are now papers
* fixed the crafting HUD opening with its skill/venue headers collapsed and piled on one spot on first open
* journal Circs headings no longer show "KEY NOT FOUND"
* three footnote choices gave 0 Experiences - they don't now
* St Reparata no longer abandons you unexpectedly when you think about her trousseau
* added interaction points to Wounds so they can be reached/used more easily
* filled the empty Witch's Knot recipe description
* moved Cambray back to 1919 and removed a circular footnote link
* on ultrawide, the dialogue page and conversation camera now respect the 16:9 letterbox
* sped up diagonal walk/run cycles to reduce the moonwalk look, especially indoors
* cursor texture fix on Linux/macOS
* swapped the generic merchant header sprite
* Antibes layering fixes
* assorted typo fixes

## 2026.7.g.12 - "RAINBOW GOATS"

* quick tweak to cursors to see if we can get them working properly on both Linux and OSX

## 2026.7.g.9 - "BETWEEN TWO DARKS"

* soundtrack is now the final mastered version
* A little more about Zèlia
* item SFX loudness levelled (and controlled properly by SFX slider)
* ultrawide: 16:9 letterbox now applies on every scene (fixing, among other screens, that bloody chargen shift)
* dialogue response links restyled
* footnote links also restyled
* character generation polish
* transient dialogue exhibits for Nina
* Plan (journal) changes now actually surfaced. A lot of them weren't poppng SORRY
* crafting intro quests. PLANS they're called PLANS
* rumours now display trace counts correctly
* fixed glitchy-square cursor on macOS
* in-game UI cursor now shown on main menu / chargen
* Refreshments option's enabled-look now matches what clicking actually does
* news menu overlapping fix (we think)
* main menu scrolling star particle fix (we hope)

## 2026.7.f.92 - "NIGHT TRAIN TO ANTIBES"

* BEWARE: saves from earlier than f.36 (the previous version) will no longer work!
* Tweaks to Spencer and Vincent animations, pathing, facing
* Punched up Nina business
* a black marketeer now sells a fake passport
* trimmed / tidied Andrée's dialogue
* Honneur et Humanité now only available after you introduce yourself to Janvier
* Sinombre conversation at night is now accessible
* tutorial zones in Antibes now disappear when triggered
* shuttered Antibes shops (Chez Felix, Librairie) now block movement when closed
* wall clock popup in sanitarium now works
* layering fixes in Antibes
* plaque text formatting tweaks in Antibes and the sanitarium
* Verdant venue now reachable
* shadow room-zone clamping fixes
* fixed a weird movement stop glitch
* Vincent relationship alerts no longer always show him in his orderly uniform
* Main Menu Options/Load sub-menus now close on Escape or by clicking outside
* new Low graphics quality tier (0.75 render scale, MSAA off)
* virgin default is now borderless fullscreen at native resolution
* fixed game alerts going dead for the rest of the session if a dialogue effect errored

## 2026.7.f.36 - "LAST TRAIN OUT OF MILAN"

* \*\*IMPORTANT - NEXT WEEK'S BUILD ("NIGHT TRAIN TO ANTIBES") WILL INVALIDATE ALL SAVES CREATED EARLIER THAN "LAST TRAIN OUT OF MILAN"
* (honestly, if you've got an old save you should delete it anyway, it'll be full of nonsense)
* you could re-craft something by hitting CRAFT again once you'd COLLECTED. But you can't any more.
* fixed abandoned hold-to-activate button presses firing out of sheer excitement next time
* equipped items now say they're equipped so you don't think you've got a duplicate
* companion assistance tooltip shows negative modifiers as -N, not +-N. I mean there aren't any negative companion modifiers rn, but who knows what Corso will get up to?
* Inventory skill modifier totals correctly show skill + modifier, rather than implying a change to the base skill
* Nice little gradient on skill modifier totals to deal with the fact that all our skill names are mad long
* skill-bar number box autosizes to fit double digits and modifers; also modifiers size the font down a bit. Not interesting? look, try writing this stuff.
* can't start boarding the train, exit out of map, then find you've left the train. YOU GOTS TO STAY ON THE MAP UNTIL YOU GO
* redesigned one-shot text - the little one-off labels that you get when you click things and don't start a full convo
* many many ordering fixes to what Lottie and I call the 'Wall of Miserable Hell With That Fecking Flowers Painting On It, Fecking'
* Spencer no longer climbs trees with helium abandon
* Leon is now visibly DangerLeon, so new players don't innocently run up to him like kittens running up to a grumpy wolf
* Janvier's mirror interaction no longer enables infinite Compassion
* all nostalgia memories now depart, with use, like trains or sunsets
* La plaque de la Rue de Racine a désormais des mots

## 2026.7.f.26 - "IN THE TRENCHES"

* fixed a nasty loop if you failed a skill check, tried the rescue, then hit Concede. In our Black Museum as 'pigiron-peony'
* fixed Aubiere's secret office never revealing itself properly
* Vincent no longer duplicates if you recruit him then go to bed. Yes literally that. And we had to rework the follower code.
* fixed Leon never learning your chosen name
* removed a loop from Leon chasing you;
* exorcist and writer now wear the correct outfits
* fixed screen staying permanently black after loading a save taken mid-fade;
* fixed camera staying locked at an interior zoom after leaving the church
* crafting: picker now shows requirement summary, opens above the slot row and auto-advances to the next empty slot
* crafted-but-uncollected items are now collected on scene transition instead of lost (ARGH)
* fixed St Oulio's Eve link (two spellings of Cambray)
* music: I spent way too much time fiddling with transitions
* Bessy's omelettes are no longer visible through walls
* crafting: reduced Tier C item requirements for Ithastry

## 2026.7.f.10 - "ANTIBES BETA II"

* crafting hud improvements
* some more Sanitarium dialogue
* Mimata dialogue tweaks
* fade added to cover Vincent's modesty
* doors show a hover outline
* camera bounds/framing improvements
* toast alert tweaks
* added \[\[links]] to the sun-cross pectoral footnote
* fixed the alt route on venue intros
* tidied up the Options menu formatting
* better interaction point for the cicatrix in the square
* better treatment of camera bounds
* Your companion can now adopt mufti
* default no-companion HUD portrait now shows properly; Spenny's idle anim no longer stares out at you like a lost soul seeking instruction
* sanitarium sprite sort-order fixes; companion HUD portrait no longer semi-transparent
* HUD button row and conditions UI redesigned, fixed HUD buttons rendering invisible-but-clickable
* fixed ghost/stuck tooltips lingering over hidden or closed map panes, info windows and menus
* fixed the inventory item tooltip flicker
* skill-check result bars (FAILURE?/RESCUED SUCCESS!) no longer drift over unrelated dialogue text
* Country/Destination map panes now raise tooltips (but I still need to link lots of them)
* Fixed a bug where some usables were only available when clicked close up or far away
* Added a third telemetry option, LINK - gives us permission to linking bug report email addresses to pseudonymous analytics data, in case that's useful for support. Theoretical at the moment.
* crafting tutorial messages now populated - NB Crafting HUD is due a haircut still
* RANDOMNESS is no longer labelled CAMERA TRACKING in options

## 2026.7.e.51 - ANTIBES BETA

* the ending of the demo is now working properly! Travel as far as the beginning of \[REDACTED]. (My pre-release-censoring code got overzealous.)
* we now have an autosave!
* manual save limit raised to 99; also, the game actually tells you when the limit kicks in
* corrupt or unreadable saves politely decline instead of breaking when you try to load them
* Inventory screen shows skill modifier effects more clearly
* wardrobe grid ordering
* IT IS HAPPENING AGAIN - remember the 'workstations no longer miaow when opened' in *Book of Hours*? well, items will no longer miaow
when dragged to an active slot in *Travelling at Night*.
* cleaned up inventory/wardrobe screen
* you can now buy the Sheaf from Andrée after exiting to search your belongings
* fixed the occasional MASSIVE ITEM APPEARS glitch on inventory screen
* Vincent no longer shows mysteriously through his room shroud
* Vincent will no longer teleport gaily into the shrubbery (or will do so with less abandon, and be easier to rescue)
* assorted small bug fixes
* first-meeting conversations could be broken if you spoke to the NPC about something in their environment
* a bookcase in Antibes is easier to reach
* removed a leftover animation experiment in Aubiere's office
* the alarm clock now works properly
* fixed a bug where skills and passions pretended they needed an extra Experience to upgrade
* fixed a problem blocking purchase of some skills that started at level 0
* typo fixes



## 2026.7.e.24 - ANTIBES BETA

* Hammering F7 while a game was already loading would try to load several versions of the scene at once, which was quite funny but not very helpful. Fixed.

## 2026.7.e.21 - ANTIBES BETA

* HOTFIX: fast-forwarding through a dialogue line while scene changes will no longer crash the game.
* HOTFIX: Spencer's dressing gown has returned (serious issue! he can't sleep naked!!)
* Spencer now moves in eight not six directions, and you'll see him animated on the Wardrobe screen
* Added beta watermark, fixed typos
A couple of fixes to our analytics + consent code, which I'll explain cos transparency is super-important with this stuff.
* We were accidentally storing something that allowed us to connect (A) the opt-in analytics about story choices with (B) the bug reports... which means we could work out what story choices you@youremail.com had made... which is an ethical amber light unless we had a clear opt-in. Today's build fixes that, and I've deleted the first day's run of story choice data. You can now kick Khione or make Vincent travel alone in third class in secure pseudonymity.
* Meanwhile, there was a bug that silently reverted YES to NO in the consent form! so we didn't gather much data anyway. Better than reverting NO to YES, I guess.

## 2026.7.e.11 - ANTIBES BETA

* THE GAME IS BEST RUN IN 16:9 ASPECT RATIOS. It will look weird in other resolutions, especially widescreen ones.
* Reporting bugs: much easier to use F10 or REPORT A BUG in game, so we have screenshots and logs. Works for feedback too. But use support@weatherfactory.biz if you need to send something longer or want to send files manually.
* This is the opening act of the game - it runs until you leave Antibes.
* UI is getting a haircut shortly.
